comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
An orange-name Ganador, he can be challenged when the World Clock is set to the 16th Century's fourth or fifth periods, or if one equips Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.4) / Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.5) titles or Age effect (16th century) EX Effect equipment. Additionally, you must have also defeated Flovisher once -- if you're able to conquer this Ganador, you will then unlock the more powerful version of John Hawkins.

Can potentially drop Scalawag Hat and Peascod-bellied Doublet items when defeated.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/List
